learning-vision.title: Philosophy & Curriculum
learning-vision.intro: Hanbit meets the world through English, with a play-based English learning journey designed for the kindergarten years.

sections.b: Through songs, play and stories, children meet English joyfully and build confidence.
With native-speaking teachers, children communicate in English all day in a natural environment.
Small classes and specialist teachers warmly support every child's growth.

learning-kindergarten.title: Kindergarten Curriculum
learning-kindergarten.intro: Centred on English, we balance social, emotional and intellectual growth through play.

sections.b: Children communicate in English all day with native-speaking teachers, learning naturally.
From K1 (ages 3–4) to K2 (ages 5–6), English education matched to each stage.

about-founders.title: Founder's Message
about-founders.intro: Hanbit honors each child's curiosity, raising capable young people who contribute to a better society.

sections.b: Through English and play, we raise children who understand the world, think for themselves and collaborate.
We build a safe, warm place to learn that every family can trust.
From our start in Seoul in 2016 to five cities nationwide — ten years of Hanbit English kindergarten education.
From our first kindergarten campus to a five-city network.
Widening access to English-immersion early education for more families.

enrichment-afterschool.title: Afterschool Programs
enrichment-afterschool.intro: A range of afterschool activities for Hanbit children.

sections.b: Ballet, dance, art, music and PE develop expression and physical growth.
English reading, phonics and drama deepen English skills.
Play-based English activities make learning joyful.
A weekend focus on English activities.

enrichment-saturday.title: Saturday School
enrichment-saturday.intro: Learning continues on weekends, with Saturday English programmes for kindergarten.

sections.b: Play-based English activities make learning joyful.
A weekend focus on English activities.
